description: This source file defines the `DeviceStatusService` class, which provides various device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and system details. It implements the `DeviceStatusServicing` protocol and interacts with system APIs like UIDevice, ProcessInfo, and FileManager to gather device metrics. The class offers methods to retrieve comprehensive device status payloads and device info payloads for application use.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A final class that provides device status and info payloads by querying system APIs and internal helpers, implementing the DeviceStatusServicing protocol.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current status of the device, including battery, thermal, storage, network, and uptime information, and returns an OpenClawDeviceStatusPayload.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns an OpenClawDeviceInfoPayload containing device identification, system, app version, build, and locale information.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Private helper method that gathers the current battery level and state, along with low power mode status.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves the system's thermal state.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Private helper method that calculates total, free, and used disk space.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Static private method that ensures the app build string is never empty, defaulting to '0' if needed.
